newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT to borrow $107.3 mln from KfW.
newsitem.headline: PLDT to borrow $107.3 mln from KfW.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank has approved an application by Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co to borrow $107.3 million from Kreditanstalt fuer Wiederaufbau (KfW) of Germany, the bank said.
The country's largest phone company is to use the loan to buy supplies and some components for its Zero Backlog Programme, bank governor Gabriel Singson told reporters at the weekend.
The programme calls for the installation of 2.2 million additional lines from 1996 up to the year 2001, PLDT has said.
PLDT estimates it needs total financing of $1.825 billion, including the loan from KFW, to complete the programme.
